activity_summary: In the afternoon you had Brooke open under the brass weight, and a clean sheet beside it with nothing written. Gib slept on the cloth over Holinshed. You did not start the girl's night today.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Pinned the book and left the folio blank.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Slept on the cloth over the chronicle.
